stopConfirm: Stop the running pipeline? Partial outputs will be kept.
projectSetup_desc: Describe your presentation requirements. Upload supporting files if you have any.
projectSetup_formatsHint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, MD, TXT, or URL · No limit on file count
style_subtitle: Choose the visual communication mode for your deck. The AI recommends the highlighted option.
style_descriptorHint: Describe the visual character (e.g. "McKinsey consulting style", "dark tech", "minimalist Scandinavian")
style_descriptorPlaceholder: e.g. McKinsey consulting style, dark tech, clean minimal...
template_subtitle: Choose a visual template for your presentation, or skip for free design.
audience_recPrefilled: ✨ AI recommendation pre-filled — review and adjust as needed
audience_whoLabel: Who is the audience? (select all that apply)
audience_occasionHint: Where and how will this presentation be used? (e.g. "annual strategy review", "investor pitch", "internal training")
audience_occasionPlaceholder: e.g. Annual strategy review, investor pitch...
audience_coreMessageHint: What is the single most important takeaway? (one sentence)
audience_coreMessagePlaceholder: e.g. Our market position requires immediate strategic pivot...
colors_hint: Click any swatch to edit its HEX. All edits submit together.
colors_empty: No colors yet. Choose a preset or add manually.
icons_subtitle: Choose one icon library for the entire deck.
icons_libraryHint: Pick one library. Mixing libraries within a single deck is forbidden.
icons_chunkDesc: Structured geometric icons with solid fills. Best for business, consulting, government decks.
icons_tablerFilledDesc: Bezier-curve forms with filled shapes. Softer, more modern look than Chunk.
icons_tablerOutlineDesc: Light outline style with adjustable stroke width (1.5/2/3). Good for screen-only or minimalist decks.
icons_phosphorDuotoneDesc: Single color + 20% backplate fill. Soft depth without solid weight. Modern UI feel.
icons_strokeHint: Deck-wide stroke width. Do not exceed 3 (at 24px strokes merge).
icons_inventoryHint: List the icon names the executor may use (comma-separated). Only icons from this list will appear.
icons_inventoryPlaceholder: target, bolt, shield, users, chart-bar, lightbulb, star, globe
typography_subtitle: Pick a font combination — the AI suggests one that fits the style.
images_subtitle: Decide how images will be handled across the deck.
images_aiGenerated: AI Generated — concept art, hero visuals
images_userProvided: User Provided — company logos, team photos
images_webSourced: Web Sourced — real-world photos, news imagery
images_notesPlaceholder: e.g. Page 3 uses Unsplash business photography...
images_defaultHint: Applied to all pages unless overridden below.
images_aiDesc: Generate images via DALL-E / Stable Diffusion. Best for conceptual visuals, hero images, mood-setting backgrounds.
images_webDesc: Search and acquire from web. Good for real-world photos, news imagery, product shots with attribution.
images_webExample: News article photos, real product images, location photos
images_userDesc: You will upload or reference your own images. Pipeline references them as-is.
images_userExample: Company logo, team photos, branded assets, charts from Excel
images_placeholderDesc: No image needed yet. Executor draws a dashed-border placeholder. Swap in real images later.
images_placeholderExample: Pages where image TBD, late-stage content, optional visuals
images_perPageHint: List specific pages that need a different strategy. One per line. Format:
images_perPagePlaceholder:
Page 1: ai — cover hero image
Page 5: user — company org chart
Page 8: placeholder — TBD
annotation_emptyHint: Click any text element in the SVG preview, then type your annotation below.
annotation_clickHint: Click an element in the SVG to annotate it
workspace_emptyHint: AI-generated outlines, specs, slide SVGs, images, and exports will appear here.
artifacts_sidebarDesc: Preview intermediate strategy files and final outputs.
artifacts_downloadReadyDesc: This artifact is best consumed as a file.
artifacts_selectHint: Select an artifact to preview it.
overlay_cancelled_desc: The pipeline was stopped by you. Start a new session to retry.
overlay_failed_desc: An error occurred and the pipeline cannot be resumed.
overlay_full_reset_desc: Clear all artifacts and source files, return to project setup.
overlay_soft_reset_desc: Keep source files, restart pipeline from Step 1.

number_gate_ai_decide: Let AI decide based on materials
